messages:
nina: dropping a quick screenshot of the Policies list in Compliance. thinking about a compact collapsed state where per-policy actions live in the header. figma: https://figma.com/file/abc/policies (frame: compact-list) — can we sanity-check order, chips, copy and a11y?

tom: quick thoughts: put region first. customers scan for residency right away.

priya: +1. also avoid standalone 'Managed key' label. its ambiguous. options: `Redwood-managed` or `Customer-managed (BYOK)` — keep parentheses for BYOK.

ava: UX: collapsed header shows an icon button (edit/pencil) that opens the modal. expanded panel keeps the full CTA. icon needs aria-label and a tooltip `Edit retention policy`.

jordan: audit event requirements: include actor, before/after, policy_id, kms_owner and region. machine-readable fields are important for compliance.

liz: microcopy proposal for chips: `eu-west-1` (region), `90 days` (retention), `Customer-managed (BYOK)` (encryption). If region unset show `Region: Unspecified` instead of `Global`.

katie: a11y checklist: header action must be a native button, keyboard focusable, 44px tap target on mobile. when expanded, add aria-live="polite" summary: `Policy details expanded: 90-day retention`. test with VoiceOver + NVDA.

nina: responsive note: the header icon must not force title truncation when window is narrow. maybe move icon into an overflow menu on small screens.

.tom: visual separators: use middot (\u00b7) only visually. screen readers should see separate labels — render as separate span elements with aria-label on each chip.

jordan: suggested audit log line (machine):
```
2025-06-02T11:02:05Z policy.update actor=liz@example.com policy_id=pol_555 action=retention:update before=30d after=90d kms_owner=customer region=eu-west-1 source=console
```

priya: human-readable audit entry for UI: `Retention policy updated from 30 days to 90 days by liz@example.com (Key: Customer-managed (BYOK), Region: eu-west-1)`. keep it explicit so compliance reviewers don't misinterpret.

ava: also avoid wording that suggests Redwood can access keys. prefer `Customer-managed (BYOK) key stored in customer's KMS` in helper text.

liz: i'll draft a small copy PR with the proposed chips and tooltip text.

katie: will run keyboard + screenreader pass on the prototype tonight and report issues here.

product-bot: New comment added to Figma by nina: "compact header: region-first chips + icon action (see comment #7)" (automated).

nina: thanks all. action items: liz=copy PR, ava=update figma with icon + overflow behavior, jordan=send audit example to infra, katie=accessibility pass. ping here if any copy still implies Redwood has key access. :thumbsup:
